name: cross-dock-grid
title: CrossDockGrid
summary: Top-down floor layout. Each cell = pallet position; color-coded by destination lane. Hover for pallet detail; click to drill in. Configurable rows × cols. Empty cells use surface-sunken; occupied cells inherit the lane's tinted color from a palette rotation.
description: Top-down cross-dock floor with color-coded pallet cells.
skillDescription: Use to visualize cross-dock floor utilization at a glance. Each cell is a pallet position; occupied cells tint by destination lane (5-lane rotation: accent / cream / amber / red / cream). Click a cell to drill into PalletTile detail. For per-pallet card view use @lumen/pallet-tile.
never: NEVER use 10+ distinct lane colors — palette is 5-rotation.
NEVER omit the hover state (it's the affordance).
a11yRules: Each cell has aria-label='Row {r} col {c}, {occupied?'pallet ' + id + ', lane ' + lane:'empty'}'.
